constraint:analyses.analyses_pkey.definition: PRIMARY KEY (stage, observation_id, input_revision, policy_version, schema_version)

FOREIGN KEY (dependency_id, dependency_revision) REFERENCES noctis_v2.claim_versions(id, revision)
